content.text:
I upgraded pi-action to pit 0.36.5 and removed pi-action's `// @pit:` header parsing, since pit's `typescript` tool now labels its calls itself. Both are new commits on **[#82](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/pull/82)**, so they ship with the `present` support. `npm run check` passes locally; CI hadn't been checked yet when I finished.

**Checking pit 0.36.5:** I ran pit's real `typescript` tool through this branch's log code with the same cases as last time, and all four problems are fixed:
- A call with no label shows `🔧 typescript` instead of falling back with a warning.
- A `saveOnly` call shows `saved hello`.
- A result without `details` uses the result text instead of throwing.
- A question shows `asked: Which?`.

No warnings appeared in that run.

**New commits on #82:**
- **`ci: run pi-assistant with pit 0.36.5`:** pins `github:cv/pit#v0.36.5` in `.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml` and in the two `extensions:` examples in `docs/extensions.md`. The `v0.35.1` example under "Tools the model sees" stays: it's there to show older pit on purpose. The new docs section also says that pit 0.36.5 and later have `present`.
- **`feat: leave pit's // @pit: header to pit's present field`:**
  - `src/activity.ts` no longer reads the `// @pit:` header. A `label` argument still labels a call.
  - The tests in `src/activity.test.ts` and the `🔧` / `↳` rows in `docs/how-it-works.md` are updated to match.

With pit 0.36.3 or earlier, a call is shown by its first line again, which is the header itself. The release notes should tell users to upgrade to pit 0.36.5.

I also updated the title and description of #82. Once it's merged, there's no pit-specific code left in pi-action's log rendering.
